C0994.title: Quanzhou Police Bust Major Game Boosting Cheat Case Involving ¥250,000, 6 Arrested
C0994.summary: In November 2025, police in Quanzhou, Fujian Province uncovered a case of using cheat software for game boosting services for profit, arresting six individuals including Xiao. Xiao had been operating an online gaming studio since 2022, purchased cheats in December 2024, and from January 2025 organized over 30 employees to use cheats for boosting, illegally profiting over ¥250,000 through services
